question: Who was appointed as the chairman of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Debasish Panda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Debasish Panda** was appointed as the chairman of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) in March 2022.
 
• Prior to his appointment, Debasish Panda served as the Secretary, Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance.
 
• His vast experience in the financial sector is expected to bring significant expertise and leadership to IRDAI.
 
• IRDAI is a statutory body tasked with regulating and promoting the insurance and reinsurance industries in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** was established by an act of Parliament in 1999.
 
• IRDAI's mission is to protect the interests of the policyholders, regulate, promote, and ensure orderly growth of the insurance industry.
 
• The authority also aims to ensure the financial stability of the insurance sector and to provide long-term funds for accelerating the growth of the economy.
 
• IRDAI's headquarters is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.
